title: Learning Robust Treatment Rules for Censored Data
abstract: arXiv:2408.09155v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: There is a fast-growing literature on estimating optimal treatment rules directly by maximizing the expected outcome. In biomedical studies and operations applications, censored survival outcomes are frequently observed, in which case the truncated mean survival time and survival probability are of great interest. In this paper, we propose two robust criteria for learning optimal treatment rules with censored survival outcomes; the former one targets an optimal treatment rule maximizing the truncated mean survival time, where the cutoff is specified by a given quantile such as the median; the latter one targets an optimal treatment rule maximizing buffered survival probabilities, where the predetermined threshold is adjusted to account for the truncated mean survival time. We develop a sampling-based difference-of-convex algorithm for learning the proposed optimal treatment rules, and provide theoretical justifications for them

translated_title: 针对删失数据学习稳健的治疗规则
translated_abstract: 目前，通过直接最大化期望结果来估计最优治疗规则的研究文献正在快速增长。在生物医学研究和运营应用中，经常观察到删失的生存结果，在这种情况下，截断平均生存时间和生存概率受到极大关注。在本文中，我们提出了两个稳健的准则，用于在删失生存结果下学习最优治疗规则：前一个准则旨在找到使截断平均生存时间最大化的最优治疗规则，其中截断点由给定的分位数（如中位数）指定；后一个准则旨在找到使缓冲生存概率最大化的最优治疗规则，其中预设阈值经过调整以考虑截断平均生存时间。我们开发了一种基于采样的差凸算法来学习所提出的最优治疗规则，并为它们提供了理论依据。
tldr: 该论文提出了两个稳健准则及基于采样的差凸算法，用于从删失生存数据中学习最优治疗规则，分别最大化截断平均生存时间和缓冲生存概率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two robust criteria and a sampling-based difference-of-convex algorithm for learning optimal treatment rules from censored survival outcomes, targeting maximization of the truncated mean survival time and buffered survival probabilities.
